review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (Montana State University, Reid Hall Renovation), pulled from the original corpus GitHub Release (not corpus_2) during an eighth batch-survey pass covering five single-file corpus_1 projects not yet used this session (03_FL_HurlburtField, 10_MO_Hawthorn, 12_MT_MSU_ReidHall, 13_MI_MSU_LifeSciences, 27_WA_ColvilleTribes). Screened for image coverage first per Run 86's own established check: `imgRatio` reads 0.00 on this sheet, real vector CAD, drawn with new-work linework highlighted in red.

A text-anchor scan found 34 bare round/rect duct callouts (`8"ø`, `16"x12"`, `20"x14"`, `14"x12"`) on this one sheet, already fully parseable with no grammar change needed. A grid sweep of ten of them found this real, clean 8.57 LF horizontal `16"x12"` trunk duct: `size:{kind:rect,w_in:16,h_in:12}`, confidence 0.5. A marked crop confirms it visually and unambiguously: a real trunk duct (drawn in the sheet's own red new-work highlight color) with its own '16"x12"' label centered directly on it, bounded on both ends by real branch-tee junctions feeding round `8"ø` takeoffs up and down to CD-8 diffusers (215 CFM each) serving Classroom 124.

Applying this session's own Run 94/95 lesson as standard practice: verified using the EXACT `bench:linear` seeding convention (`seedOnLongestSegment`) BEFORE authoring, not after -- it reproduced the identical trace exactly. `resolveRunSegments` also reproduces the identical single 8.57 LF segment.

Several other candidates on other sheets swept during this same batch-survey pass were tested against the bench-seed convention FIRST and found to fail it (the trace succeeds from an ad hoc coordinate near the label but returns no size bind from the bench's own 40%-along seed) -- MSU Life Sciences Lab Renovation's own M-004/M-005 sheets (three short candidates, 2.17-5.08 LF) and a trivially short 1.36 LF Hurlburt Field Child Development Center stub, none authored. This is a second, independent confirmation of Run 94's own seed-position-dependence finding: short duct segments with off-center labels are the ones most at risk of failing the bench's own seeding convention even when a manually-placed seed succeeds, and checking this FIRST (before investing further verification effort) is now this session's standard practice.
scope: A single real 16x12-inch rectangular supply-air (SA) trunk duct segment (8.57 LF) on the MSU Reid Hall Renovation project's own mechanical plan, sheet M2.1, bounded on both ends by real branch-tee junctions feeding round 8-inch takeoffs to CD-8 diffusers serving Classroom 124. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the duct's own continuation past either boundary; the four round 8-inch branch takeoffs visible in the same crop; a second, similarly-sized `20"x14"` candidate found on the same sheet (also bench-seed-verified successfully, but not also authored this pass); the several declined MSU Life Sciences Lab and Hurlburt Field candidates noted in review_basis; every other one of the real duct-size callouts found on this same sheet, not attempted this pass; every other sheet on this real 43-sheet plan set.
